observations: Photos show a removed vehicle drivetrain component in an auto shop setting, with hoses/lines and surrounding engine bay parts visible.
The main component appears to be a gearbox/transmission assembly (large aluminum housing, bellhousing area, multiple mounting points).
A label/plate is visible on the housing in photo 0/1/2 but the text/part number is not clearly readable from these images.
No clear Ford Fusion badge/ID is visible in the photos.
No clear evidence of mileage, testing, or internal condition is visible in the photos.

claims.evidence: Ford Fusion fitment/part number is not readable in the photos; no clear model-specific ID is shown.
No engine displacement/cylinder count or matching transmission code is readable in the photos.
No shipping/import documents or markings confirming Belgium origin are visible.

claims.claim: Tested and working, no knock, low mileage, never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not show a test run, diagnostic report, or mileage/odometer evidence; internal 'never opened' cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: Wrong transmission type/fitment for the Ford Fusion (e.g., different gearbox variant, torque converter/stator differences, or wrong bellhousing/adapter).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the transmission ID/part number label (or casting number) plus the VIN/engine code of the donor car, and confirmation of whether it is automatic/manual and the exact transmission code.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not guaranteed to fit / may require additional parts or may not work for the buyer’s exact Fusion setup.

risks.risk: Condition not truly verified (could have internal wear, leaks, or delayed failure).
risks.proof: Video of the gearbox being run/tested (engaged through gears) and/or a mechanic’s test sheet/diagnostic scan showing no faults.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: not proven working (treated like needs inspection/possible faults).

risks.risk: Leakage or damage not visible (seals, torque converter area, cooler lines, mounting cracks).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of all seals/gaskets, cooler line fittings, and any wetness/staining; plus underside inspection shots.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may leak and may need resealing.

risks.risk: Missing components/accessories (solenoids, sensors, harness connectors, mounting brackets) that affect installation.
risks.proof: Photo inventory showing included sensors/solenoids/harness connectors and all mounting brackets; confirm what is included/excluded.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst-case: may be missing parts required for installation.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the transmission label/plate with readable part number (photo 0/1/2 label area).
Transmission code + whether it is automatic or manual (and any visible gear/shift type).
Video of a test run showing engagement through gears (or diagnostic scan report with fault codes).
Photos of all seals/gaskets and any leak points; underside close-ups.
List of included parts (sensors, harness connectors, cooler lines, mounting brackets) and what is not included.
response.reason: The photos show a gearbox/transmission assembly, but the key identifiers (readable part number/ID) and proof of testing/condition are not visible. Without those, the exact fitment and working status can’t be priced confidently, so proof is needed first.
